canonical_name: 批处理事件语义完整性
formula_or_rule: each batch has capacity, compatibility class, member set, common start/end and processor identity
pass_condition: all batch candidates have complete and mutually consistent semantics
failure_interpretation: batch waiting/fill metrics are not computable and must remain semantic-only
supporting_passage_summary: Project diagnostic grounded in source batch semantics; not claimed as a paper formula.

formula_or_rule: attributed_wait_union <= observed_start - base_job_ready, with an explicit overlap allocation policy
pass_condition: attributed components neither double count overlap nor exceed observed readiness gap
failure_interpretation: machine/vehicle/worker/tool waiting metrics cannot be compared or summed
supporting_passage_summary: Project diagnostic responding to multi-resource synchronization models; not a source formula.

formula_or_rule: unique scenario IDs; nonnegative weights; declared normalization; common horizon; reproducible generator/version
pass_condition: scenario set is reproducible and weights are interpretable
failure_interpretation: CVaR, service level, expected degradation and infeasibility rate are not auditable
supporting_passage_summary: Project evidence gate for scenario-based metrics; not claimed as a literature formula.

canonical_name: 基准—重排工序映射完整性
formula_or_rule: every retained or unfinished baseline operation maps to zero or one revised operation with declared cancellation/insertion semantics
pass_condition: mapping covers all compared operations without ambiguous duplicates
supporting_passage_summary: Project diagnostic for stability computations; the sources distinguish baseline and realized/revised schedules but do not prescribe this schema.

formula_or_rule: SOC evolves consistently across travel/idle/charge intervals and remains within [minimum_SOC, capacity]
pass_condition: all SOC transitions reconcile and no task starts below required reserve
failure_interpretation: charging-wait and route feasibility conclusions are unreliable
supporting_passage_summary: Project validator for charging-aware AGV models; no source formula is claimed.
